# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

### Added
- Commit validation system with commitlint
- Automatic changelog generation with standard-version
- Interactive commit creation with Commitizen
- Git hooks with Husky for commit message validation
- Conventional Commits specification enforcement
